pages.title: Module Interface
pages.text: Carry modular equipment and press the configurable $(thing)Tool Modules$() keybind (default: Shift+C) to open its module interface. A module can only be fitted when its shape, placement limit, compatible equipment, and tier restriction are all satisfied.

pages.title: Module Types
pages.text: Modules can be divided by purpose:$(br2)$(bold)All powered equipment:$() energy.$(br)$(bold)Tools and staff:$() damage, speed, mining area, tree harvest, and junk filtering.$(br)$(bold)Chestpiece:$() shield control, capacity, recovery, movement, flight, undying, and auto-feed.$(br)$(bold)Bow:$() projectile damage, velocity, accuracy, penetration, and gravity compensation.

pages.title: Arranging Modules
pages.text: Each module occupies a different amount of space, so its shape, compatible equipment, and install limit must be checked first. A chestpiece must reserve space for Shield Control before adding shield capacity, recovery, or other functions.
